limitations: No global primary-source verification claim is made.
Text segment/choice containment can miss order, spacing, marker, image and transcription errors.
PDF hash binds a local artifact, not proof of the official acquisition chain.
Source inspection is AI agent inspection, not independent human expert certification.
Rendered question images and extracted original text remain ignored local artifacts; no original passages are re-published in tracked research files.
